status: Local draft. Not submitted to Google Play.
shortDescription: Palliative care notes, daily care and nearby support for you and your family.
fullDescription:
Sahara is a palliative care companion for patients, families and doctors.

Keep the words that matter from a goals-of-care conversation. A doctor can review the note and save a version. The patient or family can read and confirm that same version. Earlier notes and the original conversation stay available.

Record a conversation with everyone's permission, or type the words you want to keep. Add prescribed medicines, visits, questions, tasks and daily notes. Find listed palliative care centres in Karnataka, call them or get directions. Directory entries do not confirm current medicine stock.

Sign in to save care notes and daily entries to your account. Invite family or care team members to read them, or allow them to make changes. Recordings and unfinished conversations are not uploaded. Find centres on a MapLibre map or in the list. There are no ads. This version does not transcribe audio automatically, verify clinician identity or send medicine reminders.

This app is not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition, recommend treatment or replace professional medical care. Ask a qualified healthcare professional for medical advice. Care notes record a discussion; they are not prescriptions or legal directives.

dataSafetyEvidence.storage: Room cache; signed-in care records stored in Supabase. Audio and unfinished conversations remain app-private.
dataSafetyEvidence.userInitiatedSharing: Private single-use invitations with read or edit permission; Android share sheet for care notes and invitation codes.
dataSafetyEvidence.thirdPartyDestinations: Supabase receives account details and signed-in care records. OpenFreeMap receives map tile/style requests and IP address. Dialler, external maps and source pages open when selected.
dataSafetyEvidence.backup: Cloud backup and device-transfer exclusions configured
dataSafetyEvidence.note: Recheck against the final release binary and Google Play definitions before submitting the form. Any AI, sync or account integration changes these answers.

releaseDependencies: Approve and save the exact deployed Sahara confirmation/recovery callback, then configure transactional SMTP and verify end-to-end delivery for ordinary testers; the default Supabase mail service is limited to project-team addresses
Complete Play organisation verification: website ownership and association are verified; the next required field is the company's nine-digit D-U-N-S number
Create the Play listing, complete content and health declarations, and provide the confirmed review-only account from private release credentials
Upload signed AAB and verify Google's acceptance
If applicable to the account, enrol at least 12 testers continuously for 14 days, then apply for production access; this does not guarantee approval

listingAssets.screenshotEvidence: Raw 1080 x 2340 captures from the matching-source 0.3.0 debug build on Samsung A34, using synthetic Test Person records. The signed release protects screenshots with FLAG_SECURE. The nearby.png loading-state capture is QA evidence only and is not a listing asset.

appContentDraft.appAccess: Some functionality is restricted. Basic notes, daily care and the directory work without sign-in; account sync and invitations require sign-in. A dedicated reviewer account has confirmed email, successful password sign-in and an authorised empty care-record read. Its credentials are private and must be entered in Play's restricted reviewer instructions before submission.
appContentDraft.reviewInstructions: Open the app and add a person. Today shows daily care. Talk starts a goals-of-care conversation; Care shows saved versions. Nearby opens the Karnataka directory. To review account features, open Your account, sign in with the supplied review credentials, add a person and open Your account again to create or join a care invitation. Doctor is a self-selected role, not a verified credential.
appContentDraft.targetAudienceProposal: 18 and over: adult patients, family caregivers and care professionals
appContentDraft.sensitivePermissions: Microphone only, when the user starts a consented recording; no background audio, GPS, contacts, camera or photo-library permission
appContentDraft.contentRating: Complete the IARC questionnaire against the actual app; do not invent a rating or describe private shared records as public social content

dataSafetyDraft.optionalReason: The app works without an account. Account and care types leave the device for signed-in records or account requests. Provider network metadata is processed when the user uses account or map features.
dataSafetyDraft.sharingAssessment: Supabase processes signed-in records as a service provider. Care invitations and Android exports are explicit user-initiated sharing. Apply Google's stated exceptions rather than claiming that data never leaves the app.
dataSafetyDraft.audio: Recordings remain on the device and are not collected by this version.
dataSafetyDraft.networkMetadata: Provider sources checked on 10 October 2026: Supabase API logs capture IP, user-agent, IP-derived location and request diagnostics. OpenFreeMap normally omits IP from access logs, but can retain IP in error or security-incident logs. Therefore do not claim all processing is ephemeral. Network identifier and diagnostic categories conservatively cover these service logs; there is no advertising or client analytics SDK.
dataSafetyDraft.location: Approximate location is declared because Supabase infrastructure can log IP-derived city/country metadata. The app does not read GPS. The selected map area alone is not the user's physical location.
